critique: The immense turquoise ground gives the patterned orange bloom, kneeling figure, and two wing-blurred hummingbirds joyful scale and high-key restraint, while the sweeping magenta-yellow ribbons add bold cultural geometry. The Afrofuturist cosmic-mythology dimension remains unsupported—the generic flower-and-ribbon motif needs a specific celestial or mythic geometric sign rather than the unrelated striped overlay bands.
